title: agathis obtusa
intro: Agathis obtusa, commonly known as the Philippine mahogany or Prince of Mahogany, is a tree species native to Southeast Asia. The health benefits of Agathis obtusa include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve immune function, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of Agathis obtusa include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents. The bioactive constituents of Agathis obtusa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
